svg.text: HR_31p_pol: 31 parts (8 nodes, 9 elements). The signal-flow graph: who drives whom

circle: a state, a voltage held by a capacitor; square: a memory node (a floating gate); arrow: an amplifier, reading the voltage at its tail and pushing a current into the capacitor at its head (blue solid: in, vermilion dashed: out); orange dotted: its gate
The schematic: every part (9 capacitors, 8 resistors, 0 diodes, 14 transistors: 31 parts)

each net a wire, its capacitor, leak and rest voltage at its left; each amplifier a column below, wired up from the net it reads (+) and back to the net it drives; a dot is a joint, wires crossing without one don't connect; a gate: a transistor in the amplifier's tail (orange)
